description: This file implements functions related to RPC server proxies and a connector controller class within the Thunder namespace. It defines methods for obtaining default and worker pool invoke servers, and manages a singleton instance of ConnectorController.

classes.name: Engine
classes.description: A subclass of RPC::InvokeServerType<1, 0, 8> that manages server lifecycle with Acquire and Relinquish methods.

classes.name: ConnectorController
classes.description: A controller class managing a pointer to a connector, with a singleton instance.

methods.name: DefaultInvokeServer
methods.description: Returns a proxy to the default RPC invoke server, creating an Engine instance internally.

methods.name: WorkerPoolInvokeServer
methods.description: Returns a proxy to the worker pool invoke server.

methods.name: ConnectorController::~ConnectorController
methods.description: Destructor asserting that the internal controller pointer is null.
